name: AUTOPILOT.OI Owner Toolkit (4 tools)
description_html:
The Owner Toolkit: 4 simple AI helpers for the paperwork that eats your week. $40 separately, $24 here.

  • Bookkeeping Sorter: upload a statement, type sort, every expense in the right category.
  • Invoice Chaser: invoices from job notes and the right reminder for every late customer.
  • Review Desk: replies to every review in your voice, and the text that asks for new ones.
  • Content Week: 5 questions on Sunday, 7 posts for the week.

What you get: 4 PDF guides, each with a setup helper, a worked example and a cheat sheet.

How it works: add a guide to a free Claude Project, paste one message, answer 7 easy questions, then type one word. Each setup takes about 15 minutes, tap by tap.

You need: the Claude app (the free plan works), a bank statement, your payment details and your Google review link.

It does not send messages, post, file taxes or take payments.

Drafts only: you send and post everything. Not tax, legal or accounting advice. 30 day refund: reply to your receipt.

AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic. Claude is a product of Anthropic.
